description: Reviews the name inputs in form markup and nearby script. Pass `markup` (HTML, optionally with script). Detects first, last, full, middle and title or gender fields from name, id, placeholder and label, then flags a first and last pair with no single-name option, maxlength under 50, minlength over 1, patterns and regexes that allow only A to Z, required middle name or title, split-on-space logic, and missing autocomplete tokens (WCAG 1.3.5). Guidance follows W3C internationalisation material on personal names, applied as convention. Server rules and database columns are not visible. Reads the pasted source only; nothing is rendered or run, stored or logged.
name: check_name_fields
title: Name field check
